```{r}
# Folder containing your three CDC text files
project_dir <- "D:/Yikai's Graduate study/2026 Fall/P8105 data science/P8105 Final"
years <- 2023:2025

# Read one year in batches and write cleaned singleton birth records
append_year <- function(path, year, output) {
  input <- file(path, open = "rt")
  on.exit(close(input))

  total <- 0
  singletons <- 0

  repeat {
    records <- readLines(input, n = 25000L)
    if (length(records) == 0) break

    # Check the record length and birth year before extracting fields
    stopifnot(
      all(nchar(records, type = "bytes") >= 507L),
      all(substr(records, 9, 12) == as.character(year))
    )
    total <- total + length(records)

    # Plurality code 1 means a singleton birth
    records <- records[substr(records, 454, 454) == "1"]
    if (length(records) == 0) next

    age <- as.integer(substr(records, 75, 76))
    cigarettes <- as.integer(substr(records, 255, 256))
    weight <- as.integer(substr(records, 504, 507))

    # Recode unknown values before defining smoking and low birth weight
    cigarettes[cigarettes %in% 99L] <- NA_integer_
    weight[weight %in% 9999L] <- NA_integer_
    stopifnot(all(is.na(weight) | (weight >= 227 & weight <= 8165)))

    rows <- data.frame(
      year = year,
      maternal_age = age,
      cigarettes_daily_trimester1 = cigarettes,
      smoked_trimester1 = cigarettes > 0,
      birth_weight_g = weight,
      low_birth_weight = weight < 2500
    )

    write.table(
      rows, output, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA"
    )
    singletons <- singletons + nrow(rows)
  }

  stopifnot(singletons > 0)
  message(year, ": read ", total, " births; saved ", singletons, " singleton births.")
}

# Combine all three years into one compressed CSV
build_study <- function(folder, years) {
  inputs <- file.path(folder, sprintf("Nat%dPublicUS.txt", years))
  missing <- inputs[!file.exists(inputs)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing input: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  target <- file.path(folder, "birth_study_2023_2025.csv.gz")
  if (file.exists(target)) stop("Dataset already exists: ", target)

  # Give the file its final name only after all three years finish
  tmp <- tempfile("birth_study_", tmpdir = folder)
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  output <- gzfile(tmp, open = "wt")

  tryCatch({
    columns <- c(
      "year", "maternal_age", "cigarettes_daily_trimester1",
      "smoked_trimester1", "birth_weight_g", "low_birth_weight"
    )
    writeLines(paste(columns, collapse = ","), output)

    for (i in seq_along(years)) {
      message("Processing ", years[i], "...")
      append_year(inputs[i], years[i], output)
    }
  }, finally = close(output))

  if (!file.rename(tmp, target)) stop("Could not save the completed dataset.")
  message("Saved: ", target)
  target
}

study_file <- build_study(project_dir, years)
```
